techniques.name: Mobile-Agent-v3.5 (GUI-Owl-1.5)
techniques.capability_enabled: Native multi-platform GUI agent (desktop/mobile/browser) with instruct/thinking variants at 2B-235B; SOTA on 20+ GUI benchmarks (56.5 OSWorld, 71.6 AndroidWorld, 48.4 WebArena) for end-to-end software/app automation
techniques.code_evidence: Code at https://github.com/X-PLUG/MobileAgent/tree/main/Mobile-Agent-v3.5 ; GUI-Owl-1.5 model family released in multiple sizes (2B/4B/8B/32B/235B)
techniques.verbatim_quote: GUI-Owl-1.5 achieves state-of-the-art results on 20+ GUI benchmarks: 56.5 on OSWorld, 71.6 on AndroidWorld, and 48.4 on WebArena for GUI automation; 80.3 on ScreenSpotPro for grounding.

techniques.name: OpAgent: Operator Agent for Web Navigation
techniques.capability_enabled: Agentic web-navigation framework (Planner/Grounder/Reflector/Summarizer) plus single-model mode for autonomous long-horizon browser task execution; 71.6% resolve rate on WebArena
techniques.code_evidence: Code at https://github.com/codefuse-ai/OpAgent and models at https://huggingface.co/codefuse-ai/OpAgent
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code is available at https://github.com/codefuse-ai/OpAgent, and models are available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/codefuse-ai/OpAgent.

techniques.name: ColorBrowserAgent
techniques.capability_enabled: Long-horizon browser GUI agent with human-in-the-loop knowledge adaptation and progressive summarization for robust web automation; 71.2% on WebArena, 47.4% zero-shot transfer on WebChoreArena
techniques.verbatim_quote: ColorBrowserAgent achieves a state-of-the-art success rate of 71.2% on WebArena and maintains 47.4% performance under zero-shot transfer setting on WebChoreArena.

techniques.name: A-RAG: Agentic RAG via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces
techniques.capability_enabled: Agentic RAG exposing keyword_search/semantic_search/chunk_read tools in a ReAct-style loop for adaptive multi-granularity, multi-hop document retrieval; outperforms prior RAG at comparable/lower retrieved tokens
techniques.code_evidence: Code and evaluation suite are available at https://github.com/Ayanami0730/arag
techniques.verbatim_quote: A-RAG provides three retrieval tools: keyword_search, semantic_search, and chunk_read, enabling the agent to adaptively search and retrieve information across multiple granularities.

techniques.name: LegalGraphRAG: Multi-Agent Graph RAG for Legal Reasoning
techniques.capability_enabled: Hierarchical legal graph retrieval plus multi-agent (Researcher/Auditor/Adjudicator) verification for reliable evidence-grounded legal/multi-document reasoning
techniques.code_evidence: The code, datasets and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG (ACL'26 Main official code)
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code, datasets and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/LegalGraphRAG.

techniques.name: Internalized Reasoning for Long-Context Visual Document Understanding
techniques.capability_enabled: Synthetic thinking-trace pipeline + SFT + low-strength model merging that internalizes page-relevance reasoning for long visual document understanding; Qwen3-VL-32B hits 58.3 MMLongBenchDoc, beating 7x-larger 235B model
techniques.verbatim_quote: The authors release their pipeline for reproducibility and further exploration at https://github.com/lightonai/distilabel/tree/lc_sft_pipelines.

techniques.name: EHR-RAG: Long-Horizon Structured EHR Retrieval-Augmented Generation
techniques.capability_enabled: Event- and Time-Aware Hybrid retrieval over long-horizon structured EHRs for longitudinal clinical prediction, preserving temporal dependencies that exceed LLM context limits
techniques.code_evidence: No code or repository link surfaced in WebSearch result blocks; only arXiv abstract pages found
techniques.verbatim_quote: EHR-RAG is a retrieval-augmented framework designed for accurate interpretation of long-horizon structured EHR data that introduces three components tailored to longitudinal clinical prediction tasks, including Event- and Time-Aware Hybrid EHR Retrieval.
